'''2008 Worlds Team Mike Gemme DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Informal Team Tournament sheet. Header inventory Mike Gemme. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Gemme]]

* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
